items.prompt: A CSV quoted field contains a newline. What does a physical line split do?

options.text: It can break one logical record into pieces
options.why: Quoted CSV fields can contain physical newlines.

options.text: It always gives exactly one logical row per piece
It automatically validates the price as Decimal
options.why: Line splitting is not numeric validation.

options.text: It guarantees every header is unique
options.why: Header uniqueness needs an explicit check.

items.explanation: Use a configured CSV parser and then validate the resulting structure. Physical lines and logical records are different.
